snippet.title: Assassin's Creed® Liberation HD [UK]
snippet.description: Introducing Assassin's Creed® Liberation HD, the striking chapter of the pre-American Revolution Assassin's Creed saga which arrives for the first time on HD consoles (Xbox 360 and PLaystation 3) and the PC, With improved gameplay, deeper story and HD graphics  makes Liberation an immersive and full Assassin's Creed experience.
